items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: We had a drummer named Mo Strange and a bass player named Willy Burrell and Connie Ladders was playing banjo. And Frank Hines was on the piano.

ctx.x: Yeah. We had a drummer named Mo Strange and a bass player named Willy Burrell and Connie Ladders was playing banjo. And Frank Hines was on the piano. And so now I began to write a little bit. We were playing all of Fletcher Henderson's records. Now, through the study of these chords and things I'd started to write a little bit. It took me a month to make an arrangement but I finally would get the part down. And it got better and better and I was writing arrangements. And we were rehearsing. Some of the things we…
